title: 36 Hours in Minneapolis
abstract: Springtime is best for exploring this Midwestern city’s lakeside trails, robust arts scene and top-notch restaurants.

title: 36 Hours in Colorado Springs
abstract: Colorado’s second-largest city, which brims with outdoor activities, is enticing visitors with a new museum and revamped hotels.

title: 36 Hours on Minorca
abstract: This slow-paced Spanish island offers a quieter and wilder retreat than its more touristy neighbors.

title: 36 Hours in Traverse City, Mich.
abstract: A new creative energy is invigorating this laid-back northern Michigan city, loved for its cherry festival, unspoiled lake vistas and access to epic dunes.

title: 36 Hours in Porto, Portugal
abstract: Fall in love with the churches, seafood-heavy cuisine and UNESCO-listed streets of Portugal’s second-largest city.
